reference.criterion: About $1,000 purchases the forecast’s roughly 10^16 calculations/second brain-hardware budget, using an explicit arithmetic proxy.
reference.rationale: A 2020 RTX 3080 delivered roughly 3×10^13 FP32 operations/second, well below 10^16 even before the rest of the PC. The checked $999-launch RTX 5080 class remains below 10^16 even using the much less comparable low-precision AI figure. The constant-dollar adjustment does not bridge the large FP32 gap.

broader.rationale: Useful AI does not establish whole-brain throughput or general human intelligence; this task-capability reading is only partially realized.
